032    /**
033     * Set tg geo points from the client points
034     *
035     * @param milStd
036     * @param tg
037     */
038    private static void setClientCoords(MilStdSymbol milStd,
039            TGLight tg) {
040        try {
041            ArrayList<POINT2> latLongs = new ArrayList();
042            int j = 0;
043            ArrayList<Point2D> coords = milStd.getCoordinates();
044            Point2D pt2d = null;
045            POINT2 pt2 = null;
046            int n = coords.size();
047            //for (j = 0; j < coords.size(); j++) 
048            for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
049                pt2d = coords.get(j);
050                pt2 = clsUtility.Point2DToPOINT2(pt2d);
051                latLongs.add(pt2);
052            }
053            tg.set_LatLongs(latLongs);
054        } catch (Exception exc) {
055            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsRenderer", "setClientCoords",
056                    new RendererException("Failed to set geo points or pixels for " + milStd.getSymbolID(), exc));
057        }
058    }
059
060    private static ArrayList<Point2D> getClientCoords(TGLight tg) {
061        ArrayList<Point2D> coords = null;
062        try {
063            int j = 0;
064            Point2D pt2d = null;
065            POINT2 pt2 = null;
066            coords = new ArrayList();
067            int n = tg.LatLongs.size();
068            //for (j = 0; j < tg.LatLongs.size(); j++) 
069            for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
070                pt2 = tg.LatLongs.get(j);
071                pt2d = new Point2D.Double(pt2.x, pt2.y);
072                coords.add(pt2d);
073            }
074        } catch (Exception exc) {
075            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsRenderer", "getClientCoords",
076                    new RendererException("Failed to set geo points or pixels for " + tg.get_SymbolId(), exc));
077        }
078        return coords;
079    }
080
081    /**
082     * Create MilStdSymbol from tactical graphic
083     *
084     * @deprecated
085     * @param tg tactical graphic
086     * @param converter geographic to pixels to converter
087     * @return MilstdSymbol object
088     */
089    public static MilStdSymbol createMilStdSymboFromTGLight(TGLight tg, IPointConversion converter) {
090        MilStdSymbol milStd = null;
091        try {
092            String symbolId = tg.get_SymbolId();
093            int std = tg.getSymbologyStandard();
094            armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.initializeLinetypes(std);
095            int lineType = armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.GetLinetypeFromString(symbolId);
096            String status = tg.get_Status();
097            if (status != null && status.equals("A")) {
098                if (armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.isBasicShape(lineType) == false) {
099                }
100            }
101            //build tg.Pixels
102            tg.Pixels = clsUtility.LatLongToPixels(tg.LatLongs, converter);
103            boolean isClosedArea = armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.isClosedPolygon(lineType);
104            if (isClosedArea) {
105                armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.ClosePolygon(tg.Pixels);
106                armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.ClosePolygon(tg.LatLongs);
107            }
108
109            ArrayList<Point2D> coords = getClientCoords(tg);
110            tg.set_Font(new Font("Arial", Font.PLAIN, 12));
111            SparseArray<String> modifiers = new SparseArray<String>();
112            modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.W_DTG_1, tg.get_DTG());
113            modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.W1_DTG_2, tg.get_DTG1());
114            modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.H_ADDITIONAL_INFO_1, tg.get_H());
115            modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.H1_ADDITIONAL_INFO_2, tg.get_H1());
116            modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.H2_ADDITIONAL_INFO_3, tg.get_H2());
117            modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.T_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_1, tg.get_Name());
118            modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.T1_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_2, tg.get_T1());
119            modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.Y_LOCATION, tg.get_Location());
120            modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.N_HOSTILE, tg.get_N());
121
122            milStd = new MilStdSymbol(symbolId, "1", coords, modifiers);
123            milStd.setFillColor(tg.get_FillColor());
124            milStd.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
125            milStd.setLineWidth(tg.get_LineThickness());
126            milStd.setFillStyle(tg.get_TexturePaint());
127        } catch (Exception exc) {
128            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsRenderer", "createMilStdSymboFromTGLight",
129                    new RendererException("Failed to set geo points or pixels for " + tg.get_SymbolId(), exc));
130        }
131        return milStd;
132    }
133
134    /**
135     * Build a tactical graphic object from the client MilStdSymbol
136     *
137     * @param milStd MilstdSymbol object
138     * @param converter geographic to pixels converter
139     * @return tactical graphic
140     */
141    public static TGLight createTGLightFromMilStdSymbol(MilStdSymbol milStd,
142            IPointConversion converter) {
143        TGLight tg = new TGLight();
144        try {
145            String symbolId = milStd.getSymbolID();
146            int std = milStd.getSymbologyStandard();
147            tg.setSymbologyStandard(std);
148            armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.initializeLinetypes(std);
149            tg.set_SymbolId(symbolId);
150            boolean useLineInterpolation = milStd.getUseLineInterpolation();
151            tg.set_UseLineInterpolation(useLineInterpolation);
152            //int lineType = armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.GetLinetypeFromString(symbolId);
153            int lineType = getRevDLinetype(tg);
154            tg.set_LineType(lineType);
155            String status = tg.get_Status();
156            if (status != null && status.equals("A")) {
157                if (armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.isBasicShape(lineType) == false) {
158                    tg.set_LineStyle(1);
159                }
160            }
161            tg.set_VisibleModifiers(true);
162            //set tg latlongs and pixels
163            setClientCoords(milStd, tg);
164            //build tg.Pixels
165            tg.Pixels = clsUtility.LatLongToPixels(tg.LatLongs, converter);
166            //tg.set_Font(new Font("Arial", Font.PLAIN, 12));
167            RendererSettings r = RendererSettings.getInstance();
168            int type = r.getMPModifierFontType();
169            String name = r.getMPModifierFontName();
170            int sz = r.getMPModifierFontSize();
171            Font font = new Font(name, type, sz);
172            tg.set_Font(font);
173            tg.set_FillColor(milStd.getFillColor());
174            tg.set_LineColor(milStd.getLineColor());
175            tg.set_LineThickness(milStd.getLineWidth());
176            tg.set_TexturePaint(milStd.getFillStyle());
177            if(armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.isBasicShape(lineType))            
178                tg.set_Fillstyle(milStd.getPatternFillType());            
179            tg.set_FontBackColor(Color.WHITE);
180            tg.set_TextColor(tg.get_LineColor());
181            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.W_DTG_1) != null) {
182                tg.set_DTG(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.W_DTG_1));
183            }
184            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.W1_DTG_2) != null) {
185                tg.set_DTG1(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.W1_DTG_2));
186            }
187            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.H_ADDITIONAL_INFO_1) != null) {
188                tg.set_H(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.H_ADDITIONAL_INFO_1));
189            }
190            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.H1_ADDITIONAL_INFO_2) != null) {
191                tg.set_H1(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.H1_ADDITIONAL_INFO_2));
192            }
193            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.H2_ADDITIONAL_INFO_3) != null) {
194                tg.set_H2(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.H2_ADDITIONAL_INFO_3));
195            }
196            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.T_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_1) != null) {
197                tg.set_Name(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.T_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_1));
198            }
199            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.T1_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_2) != null) {
200                tg.set_T1(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.T1_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_2));
201            }
202            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.Y_LOCATION) != null) {
203                tg.set_Location(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.Y_LOCATION));
204            }
205            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.N_HOSTILE) != null) {
206                tg.set_N(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.N_HOSTILE));
207            }
208            tg.set_UseDashArray(milStd.getUseDashArray());
209            tg.set_UseHatchFill(milStd.getUseFillPattern());
210            //tg.set_UsePatternFill(milStd.getUseFillPattern());
211            tg.set_HideOptionalLabels(milStd.getHideOptionalLabels());
212            boolean isClosedArea = armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.isClosedPolygon(lineType);
213
214            //implement two point belt
215            if(lineType==TacticalLines.BELT && tg.Pixels.size()==2)
216            {
217                POINT2 pt0=tg.Pixels.get(0);
218                POINT2 pt1=tg.Pixels.get(1);
219                POINT2 p0=lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0,pt1,pt0,2,5);
220                POINT2 p1=lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0,pt1,pt1,2,5);
221                POINT2 p2=lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0,pt1,pt1,3,5);
222                POINT2 p3=lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0,pt1,pt0,3,5);
223                tg.Pixels.clear();
224                tg.Pixels.add(p0);
225                tg.Pixels.add(p1);
226                tg.Pixels.add(p2);
227                tg.Pixels.add(p3);
228                tg.LatLongs = clsUtility.PixelsToLatLong(tg.Pixels, converter);            
229            }            
230            if (isClosedArea) {
231                armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.ClosePolygon(tg.Pixels);
232                armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.ClosePolygon(tg.LatLongs);
233            }
234
235            //implement meters to feet for altitude labels
236            String altitudeLabel = milStd.getAltitudeMode();
237            if (altitudeLabel == null || altitudeLabel.isEmpty()) {
238                altitudeLabel = "MSL";
239            }
240            DistanceUnit altitudeUnit = milStd.getAltitudeUnit();
241            if(altitudeUnit == null){
242                altitudeUnit = DistanceUnit.FEET;
243            }
244            DistanceUnit distanceUnit = milStd.getDistanceUnit();
245            if(distanceUnit == null){
246                distanceUnit = DistanceUnit.METERS;
247            }
248
249            double x_alt = 0;
250            int n_alt = 0;
251            String strXAlt = "";
252            //construct the H1 and H2 modifiers for sector from the mss AM, AN, and X arraylists
253            if (lineType == TacticalLines.BS_ELLIPSE || lineType == TacticalLines.PBS_ELLIPSE || lineType == TacticalLines.PBS_CIRCLE) {
254                ArrayList<Double> AM = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
255                ArrayList<Double> AN = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH);
256                //ensure array length 3
257                double r2=0;
258                double b=0;
259                if(AM.size()==1)
260                {
261                    r2=AM.get(0);
262                    AM.add(r2);                
263                    AM.add(0d);
264                }
265                else if(AM.size()==2)
266                {
267                    r2=AM.get(0);
268                    b=AM.get(1);
269                    AM.set(1, r2);
270                    AM.add(b);
271                }
272                if (AN == null) {
273                    AN = new ArrayList<Double>();
274                }
275                if (AN.size() < 1) {
276                    AN.add(new Double(0));
277                }
278                if (lineType == TacticalLines.PBS_CIRCLE) //circle
279                {
280                    double am0 = AM.get(0);
281                    if (AM.size() == 1) {
282                        AM.add(am0);
283                    } else if (AM.size() >= 2) {
284                        AM.set(1, am0);
285                    }
286                }
287                if (AM != null && AM.size() >= 2 && AN != null && AN.size() >= 1) {
288                    POINT2 ptAzimuth = new POINT2(0, 0);
289                    ptAzimuth.x = AN.get(0);
290                    POINT2 ptCenter = tg.Pixels.get(0);
291                    POINT2 pt0 = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(tg.LatLongs.get(0), AM.get(0), 90);//semi-major axis
292                    POINT2 pt1 = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(tg.LatLongs.get(0), AM.get(1), 0);//semi-minor axis
293                    Point2D pt02d = new Point2D.Double(pt0.x, pt0.y);
294                    Point2D pt12d = new Point2D.Double(pt1.x, pt1.y);
295                    pt02d = converter.GeoToPixels(pt02d);
296                    pt12d = converter.GeoToPixels(pt12d);
297                    pt0 = new POINT2(pt02d.getX(), pt02d.getY());
298                    pt1 = new POINT2(pt12d.getX(), pt12d.getY());
299                    tg.Pixels = new ArrayList<POINT2>();
300                    tg.Pixels.add(ptCenter);
301                    tg.Pixels.add(pt0);
302                    tg.Pixels.add(pt1);
303                    tg.Pixels.add(ptAzimuth);
304                }
305                if(AM != null && AM.size()>2)
306                {
307                    //use AM[2] for the buffer, so PBS_CIRCLE requires AM size 3 like PBS_ELLIPSE to use a buffer
308                    double dist=AM.get(2);
309                    POINT2 pt0=mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(tg.LatLongs.get(0), dist, 45);   //azimuth 45 is arbitrary
310                    Point2D pt02d = new Point2D.Double(tg.LatLongs.get(0).x,tg.LatLongs.get(0).y);
311                    Point2D pt12d = new Point2D.Double(pt0.x, pt0.y);
312                    pt02d = converter.GeoToPixels(pt02d);
313                    pt12d = converter.GeoToPixels(pt12d);
314                    pt0=new POINT2(pt02d.getX(),pt02d.getY());
315                    POINT2 pt1=new POINT2(pt12d.getX(),pt12d.getY());                   
316                    dist=lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0, pt1);
317                    //arraysupport will use line style to create the buffer shape
318                    tg.Pixels.get(0).style=(int)dist;
319                }
320            }
321            if (lineType == TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_SECTOR) {
322                ArrayList<Double> AM = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
323                ArrayList<Double> AN = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH);
324                ArrayList<Double> X = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.X_ALTITUDE_DEPTH);
325                if (AM != null) {
326                    String strT1 = "";
327                    for (int j = 0; j < AM.size(); j++) {
328                        strT1 += Double.toString(AM.get(j));
329                        if (j < AM.size() - 1) {
330                            strT1 += ",";
331                        }
332                    }
333                    tg.set_T1(strT1);
334                }
335                if (AN != null) {
336                    String strT = "";
337                    //String az = "";
338                    for (int j = 0; j < AN.size(); j++) {
339                        strT += AN.get(j);
340                        if (j < AN.size() - 1) {
341                            strT += ",";
342                        }
343                    }
344                    tg.set_Name(strT);
345                }
346                if (X != null) {
347                    String strH1 = "";
348                    for (int j = 0; j < X.size(); j++) {
349                        //strH1 += Double.toString(X.get(j));
350                        x_alt = X.get(j);
351                        //strXAlt=Double.toString(x_alt)+" ft. "+altitudeLabel;
352                        x_alt *= 10.0;
353                        x_alt = Math.round(x_alt);
354                        n_alt = (int) x_alt;
355                        x_alt = n_alt / 10.0;
356                        strXAlt = createAltitudeLabel(x_alt, altitudeUnit, altitudeLabel);
357                        strH1 += strXAlt;
358
359                        if (j < X.size() - 1) {
360                            strH1 += ",";
361                        }
362                    }
363                    tg.set_H1(strH1);
364                }
365                if (AM != null && AN != null) {
366                    int numSectors = AN.size() / 2;
367                    double left, right, min = 0, max = 0;
368                    //construct left,right,min,max from the arraylists
369                    String strLeftRightMinMax = "";
370                    for (int j = 0; j < numSectors; j++) {
371                        left = AN.get(2 * j);
372                        right = AN.get(2 * j + 1);
373                        if (j + 1 == AM.size()) {
374                            break;
375                        }
376                        min = AM.get(j);
377                        max = AM.get(j + 1);
378                        strLeftRightMinMax += Double.toString(left) + "," + Double.toString(right) + "," + Double.toString(min) + "," + Double.toString(max);
379                        if (j < numSectors - 1) {
380                            strLeftRightMinMax += ",";
381                        }
382
383                    }
384                    int len = strLeftRightMinMax.length();
385                    String c = strLeftRightMinMax.substring(len - 1, len);
386                    if (c.equalsIgnoreCase(",")) {
387                        strLeftRightMinMax = strLeftRightMinMax.substring(0, len - 1);
388                    }
389                    tg.set_H2(strLeftRightMinMax);
390                }
391            }
392            int j = 0;
393            if (lineType == TacticalLines.BBS_RECTANGLE || lineType == TacticalLines.BS_BBOX) {
394                double minLat = tg.LatLongs.get(0).y;
395                double maxLat = tg.LatLongs.get(0).y;
396                double minLong = tg.LatLongs.get(0).x;
397                double maxLong = tg.LatLongs.get(0).x;
398                for (j = 1; j < tg.LatLongs.size(); j++) {
399                    if (tg.LatLongs.get(j).x < minLong) {
400                        minLong = tg.LatLongs.get(j).x;
401                    }
402                    if (tg.LatLongs.get(j).x > maxLong) {
403                        maxLong = tg.LatLongs.get(j).x;
404                    }
405                    if (tg.LatLongs.get(j).y < minLat) {
406                        minLat = tg.LatLongs.get(j).y;
407                    }
408                    if (tg.LatLongs.get(j).y > maxLat) {
409                        maxLat = tg.LatLongs.get(j).y;
410                    }
411                }
412                tg.LatLongs = new ArrayList();
413                tg.LatLongs.add(new POINT2(minLong, maxLat));
414                tg.LatLongs.add(new POINT2(maxLong, maxLat));
415                tg.LatLongs.add(new POINT2(maxLong, minLat));
416                tg.LatLongs.add(new POINT2(minLong, minLat));
417                if (lineType == TacticalLines.BS_BBOX) {
418                    tg.LatLongs.add(new POINT2(minLong, maxLat));
419                }
420                tg.Pixels = clsUtility.LatLongToPixels(tg.LatLongs, converter);
421            }
422            //these have a buffer value in meters which we'll stuff tg.H2
423            //and use the style member of tg.Pixels to stuff the buffer width in pixels
424            switch (lineType) {
425                case TacticalLines.BBS_AREA:
426                case TacticalLines.BBS_LINE:
427                case TacticalLines.BBS_RECTANGLE:
428                    String H2 = null;
429                    double dist = 0;
430                    POINT2 pt0;
431                    POINT2 pt1;//45 is arbitrary
432                    ArrayList<Double> AM = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
433                    if (AM != null && AM.size() > 0) {
434                        H2 = AM.get(0).toString();
435                        tg.set_H2(H2);
436                    }
437                    if (H2 != null && !H2.isEmpty()) {
438                        for (j = 0; j < tg.LatLongs.size(); j++) {
439                            if (tg.LatLongs.size() > j) {
440                                if (!Double.isNaN(Double.parseDouble(H2))) {
441                                    if (j == 0) {
442                                        dist = Double.parseDouble(H2);
443                                        pt0 = new POINT2(tg.LatLongs.get(0));
444                                        pt1 = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(pt0, dist, 45);//45 is arbitrary
445                                        Point2D pt02d = new Point2D.Double(pt0.x, pt0.y);
446                                        Point2D pt12d = new Point2D.Double(pt1.x, pt1.y);
447                                        pt02d = converter.GeoToPixels(pt02d);
448                                        pt12d = converter.GeoToPixels(pt12d);
449                                        pt0.x = pt02d.getX();
450                                        pt0.y = pt02d.getY();
451                                        pt1.x = pt12d.getX();
452                                        pt1.y = pt12d.getY();
453                                        dist = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0, pt1);
454                                    }
455                                    tg.Pixels.get(j).style = Math.round((float) dist);
456                                } else {
457                                    tg.Pixels.get(j).style = 0;
458                                }
459                            }
460                        }
461                    }
462                    break;
463                default:
464                    break;
465            }
466            if (lineType == TacticalLines.LAUNCH_AREA) //geo ellipse
467            {
468                ArrayList<Double> AM = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
469                ArrayList<Double> AN = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH);
470                if (AM != null && AM.size() > 1) {
471                    String H = AM.get(0).toString();  //major axis
472                    tg.set_H(H);
473                    String T1 = AM.get(1).toString(); //minor axis
474                    tg.set_T1(T1);
475                }
476                if (AN != null && AN.size() > 0) {
477                    String H2 = AN.get(0).toString(); //rotation
478                    tg.set_H2(H2);
479                }
480            }
481            switch (lineType) {
482                case TacticalLines.ROZ:
483                case TacticalLines.FAADZ:
484                case TacticalLines.HIDACZ:
485                case TacticalLines.MEZ:
486                case TacticalLines.LOMEZ:
487                case TacticalLines.HIMEZ:
488                case TacticalLines.ACA:
489                case TacticalLines.ACA_RECTANGULAR:
490                case TacticalLines.ACA_CIRCULAR:
491                    ArrayList<Double> X = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.X_ALTITUDE_DEPTH);
492                    if (X != null && X.size() > 0) {
493                        //tg.set_H(Double.toString(X.get(0)));
494                        x_alt = X.get(0);
495                        //strXAlt=Double.toString(x_alt)+" ft. "+altitudeLabel;
496                        x_alt *= 10.0;
497                        x_alt = Math.round(x_alt);
498                        n_alt = (int) x_alt;
499                        x_alt = n_alt / 10.0;
500                        strXAlt = createAltitudeLabel(x_alt, altitudeUnit, altitudeLabel);
501                        tg.set_H(strXAlt);
502                    }
503                    if (X != null && X.size() > 1) {
504                        //tg.set_H1(Double.toString(X.get(1)));
505                        x_alt = X.get(1);
506                        //strXAlt=Double.toString(x_alt)+" ft. "+altitudeLabel;
507                        x_alt *= 10.0;
508                        x_alt = Math.round(x_alt);
509                        n_alt = (int) x_alt;
510                        x_alt = n_alt / 10.0;
511                        strXAlt = createAltitudeLabel(x_alt, altitudeUnit, altitudeLabel);
512                        tg.set_H1(strXAlt);
513                    }
514                    break;
515                case TacticalLines.UAV:
516                case TacticalLines.MRR:
517                case TacticalLines.UAV_USAS:
518                case TacticalLines.MRR_USAS:
519                case TacticalLines.LLTR:
520                case TacticalLines.AC:
521                case TacticalLines.SAAFR:
522                    POINT2 pt = tg.LatLongs.get(0);
523                    Point2D pt2d0 = new Point2D.Double(pt.x, pt.y);
524                    Point2D pt2d0Pixels = converter.GeoToPixels(pt2d0);
525                    POINT2 pt0Pixels = new POINT2(pt2d0Pixels.getX(), pt2d0Pixels.getY());
526
527                    //get some point 10000 meters away from pt
528                    //10000 should work for any scale                    
529                    double dist = 10000;
530                    POINT2 pt2 = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(pt, dist, 0);
531                    Point2D pt2d1 = new Point2D.Double(pt2.x, pt2.y);
532                    Point2D pt2d1Pixels = converter.GeoToPixels(pt2d1);
533                    POINT2 pt1Pixels = new POINT2(pt2d1Pixels.getX(), pt2d1Pixels.getY());
534                    //calculate pixels per meter
535                    double distPixels = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0Pixels, pt1Pixels);
536                    double pixelsPerMeter = distPixels / dist;
537
538                    ArrayList<Double> AM = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
539                    if (AM != null) {
540                        String H2 = "";
541                        for (j = 0; j < AM.size(); j++) {
542                            H2 += AM.get(j).toString();
543                            if (j < AM.size() - 1) {
544                                H2 += ",";
545                            }
546                        }
547                        tg.set_H2(H2);
548                    }
549                    String[] strRadii = null;
550                    //get the widest vaule
551                    //the current requirement is to use the greatest width as the default width
552                    double maxWidth = 0,
553                     temp = 0;
554                    double maxWidthMeters = 0;
555                    if (tg.get_H2() != null && tg.get_H2().isEmpty() == false) {
556                        strRadii = tg.get_H2().split(",");
557                        if (strRadii != null && strRadii.length > 0) {
558                            for (j = 0; j < strRadii.length; j++) {
559                                if (!Double.isNaN(Double.parseDouble(strRadii[j]))) {
560                                    temp = Double.parseDouble(strRadii[j]);
561                                    if (temp > maxWidth) {
562                                        maxWidth = temp;
563                                    }
564                                }
565                            }
566                            maxWidthMeters = maxWidth;
567                            maxWidth *= pixelsPerMeter / 2;
568                        }
569                    }
570                    //double defaultPixels=maxWidth;
571                    //if AM is null we default to using the value from H2 to set tg.Pixels.get(j).style                                   
572                    //hopefully H2 was set, either by the client or by stuffing it from AM
573                    if (tg.get_H2() != null && tg.get_H2().isEmpty() == false) {
574                        if (strRadii != null && strRadii.length > 0) {
575                            //assume it's a comma delimited string
576                            //double pixels=Double.valueOf(tg.get_H2())*pixelsPerMeter;
577                            double pixels = 0;
578                            //defaultPixels=Double.valueOf(strRadii[0])*pixelsPerMeter/2;
579                            //for(j=0;j<strRadii.length;j++)
580                            for (j = 0; j < tg.Pixels.size(); j++) {
581                                //pixels=defaultPixels;
582                                if (tg.Pixels.size() > j) {
583                                    if (strRadii.length > j) {
584                                        if (!Double.isNaN(Double.parseDouble(strRadii[j]))) {
585                                            pixels = Double.parseDouble(strRadii[j]) * pixelsPerMeter / 2;
586                                            tg.Pixels.get(j).style = (int) pixels;
587                                            tg.LatLongs.get(j).style = (int) pixels;
588                                        } else {
589                                            tg.Pixels.get(j).style = (int) maxWidth;
590                                            tg.LatLongs.get(j).style = (int) maxWidth;
591                                        }
592                                    } else {
593                                        tg.Pixels.get(j).style = (int) maxWidth;
594                                        tg.LatLongs.get(j).style = (int) maxWidth;
595                                    }
596                                }
597                            }
598                        }
599                    }
600
601                    maxWidthMeters *= distanceUnit.conversionFactor;
602                    maxWidthMeters *= 10.0;
603                    maxWidthMeters = Math.round(maxWidthMeters);
604                    int tempWidth = (int) maxWidthMeters;
605                    maxWidthMeters = tempWidth / 10.0;
606
607                    //now set tg.H2 to the max value so that the H2 modifier will display as the max vaule;
608                    tg.set_H2(Double.toString(maxWidthMeters) + " " + distanceUnit.label);
609                    //use X, X1 to set tg.H, tg.H1
610                    X = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.X_ALTITUDE_DEPTH);
611                    if (X != null && X.size() > 0) {
612                        //tg.set_H(Double.toString(X.get(0)));
613                        x_alt = X.get(0);
614                        //strXAlt=Double.toString(x_alt)+" ft. "+altitudeLabel;
615                        x_alt *= 10.0;
616                        x_alt = Math.round(x_alt);
617                        n_alt = (int) x_alt;
618                        x_alt = n_alt / 10.0;
619                        strXAlt = createAltitudeLabel(x_alt, altitudeUnit, altitudeLabel);
620                        tg.set_H(strXAlt);
621                    }
622                    if (X != null && X.size() > 1) {
623                        //tg.set_H1(Double.toString(X.get(1)));
624                        x_alt = X.get(1);
625                        //strXAlt=Double.toString(x_alt)+" ft. "+altitudeLabel;
626                        x_alt *= 10.0;
627                        x_alt = Math.round(x_alt);
628                        n_alt = (int) x_alt;
629                        x_alt = n_alt / 10.0;
630                        strXAlt = createAltitudeLabel(x_alt, altitudeUnit, altitudeLabel);
631                        tg.set_H1(strXAlt);
632                    }
633                    break;
634                default:
635                    break;
636            }
637            //killl box purple evidently uses the X modifier (Rev C)
638            switch (lineType) {
639                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE:
640                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE_CIRCULAR:
641                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE_RECTANGULAR:
642                    ArrayList<Double> X = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.X_ALTITUDE_DEPTH);
643                    String strH1 = "";
644                    if (X != null && !X.isEmpty()) {
645                        //strH1 = Double.toString(X.get(0));
646                        //tg.set_H1(strH1);
647                        x_alt = X.get(0);
648                        //strXAlt=Double.toString(x_alt)+" ft. "+altitudeLabel;
649                        x_alt *= 10.0;
650                        x_alt = Math.round(x_alt);
651                        n_alt = (int) x_alt;
652                        x_alt = n_alt / 10.0;
653                        strXAlt = createAltitudeLabel(x_alt, altitudeUnit, altitudeLabel);
654                        tg.set_H1(strXAlt);
655                    }
656                    break;
657                default:
658                    break;
659            }
660            //circular range fans
661            if (lineType == TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN) {
662                ArrayList<Double> AM = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
663                ArrayList<Double> X = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.X_ALTITUDE_DEPTH);
664                String strH2 = "";
665                String strH1 = "";
666                if (AM != null) {
667                    for (j = 0; j < AM.size(); j++) {
668                        strH2 += Double.toString(AM.get(j));
669                        if (j < AM.size() - 1) {
670                            strH2 += ",";
671                        }
672
673                        if (X != null && j < X.size()) {
674                            //strH1 += Double.toString(X.get(j));
675                            x_alt = X.get(j);
676                            //strXAlt=Double.toString(x_alt)+" ft. "+altitudeLabel;
677                            x_alt *= 10.0;
678                            x_alt = Math.round(x_alt);
679                            n_alt = (int) x_alt;
680                            x_alt = n_alt / 10.0;
681                            strXAlt = createAltitudeLabel(x_alt, altitudeUnit, altitudeLabel);
682                            strH1 += strXAlt;
683                            if (j < X.size() - 1) {
684                                strH1 += ",";
685                            }
686                        }
687
688                        //rev C has a maxiimum of 3 circles
689                        if (j == 2) {
690                            break;
691                        }
692                    }
693                }
694                tg.set_H2(strH2);
695                tg.set_H1(strH1);
696            }
697            switch (lineType) {
698                case TacticalLines.BBS_AREA:
699                case TacticalLines.BBS_LINE:
700                case TacticalLines.BBS_POINT:
701                case TacticalLines.BBS_RECTANGLE:
702                    if (tg.get_FillColor() == null) {
703                        tg.set_FillColor(Color.LIGHT_GRAY);
704                    }
705                    break;
706                default:
707                    break;
708            }
709            //Mil-Std-2525C stuff
710            switch (lineType) {
711                case TacticalLines.PAA_RECTANGULAR_REVC:
712                case TacticalLines.FSA_RECTANGULAR:
713                case TacticalLines.FFA_RECTANGULAR:
714                case TacticalLines.ACA_RECTANGULAR:
715                case TacticalLines.NFA_RECTANGULAR:
716                case TacticalLines.RFA_RECTANGULAR:
717                case TacticalLines.ATI_RECTANGULAR:
718                case TacticalLines.CFFZ_RECTANGULAR:
719                case TacticalLines.SENSOR_RECTANGULAR:
720                case TacticalLines.CENSOR_RECTANGULAR:
721                case TacticalLines.DA_RECTANGULAR:
722                case TacticalLines.CFZ_RECTANGULAR:
723                case TacticalLines.ZOR_RECTANGULAR:
724                case TacticalLines.TBA_RECTANGULAR:
725                case TacticalLines.TVAR_RECTANGULAR:
726                case TacticalLines.CIRCULAR:
727                case TacticalLines.FSA_CIRCULAR:
728                case TacticalLines.ACA_CIRCULAR:
729                case TacticalLines.FFA_CIRCULAR:
730                case TacticalLines.NFA_CIRCULAR:
731                case TacticalLines.RFA_CIRCULAR:
732                case TacticalLines.PAA_CIRCULAR:
733                case TacticalLines.ATI_CIRCULAR:
734                case TacticalLines.CFFZ_CIRCULAR:
735                case TacticalLines.SENSOR_CIRCULAR:
736                case TacticalLines.CENSOR_CIRCULAR:
737                case TacticalLines.DA_CIRCULAR:
738                case TacticalLines.CFZ_CIRCULAR:
739                case TacticalLines.ZOR_CIRCULAR:
740                case TacticalLines.TBA_CIRCULAR:
741                case TacticalLines.TVAR_CIRCULAR:
742                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXBLUE_CIRCULAR:
743                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE_CIRCULAR:
744                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXBLUE_RECTANGULAR:
745                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE_RECTANGULAR:
746                case TacticalLines.BBS_POINT:
747                    ArrayList<Double> AM = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
748                    if (AM != null && AM.size() > 0) {
749                        String strT1 = Double.toString(AM.get(0));
750                        //set width for rectangles or radius for circles
751                        tg.set_T1(strT1);
752                    } else if (lineType == TacticalLines.BBS_POINT && tg.LatLongs.size() > 1) {
753                        double dist = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(tg.LatLongs.get(0), tg.LatLongs.get(1), null, null);
754                        String strT1 = Double.toString(dist);
755                        tg.set_T1(strT1);
756                    }
757                    break;
758                default:
759                    break;
760            }
761            //Mil-std-2525C
762            if (lineType == TacticalLines.RECTANGULAR || lineType == TacticalLines.PBS_RECTANGLE || lineType == TacticalLines.PBS_SQUARE) {
763                ArrayList<Double> AM = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
764                ArrayList<Double> AN = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH);
765                if (lineType == TacticalLines.PBS_SQUARE) //for square
766                {
767                    double r2=AM.get(0);
768                    double b=0;
769                    if(AM.size()==1)
770                    {
771                        AM.add(r2);
772                        AM.add(b);
773                    }
774                    else if(AM.size()==2)
775                    {
776                        b=AM.get(1);
777                        AM.set(1,r2);
778                        AM.add(b);
779                    }
780                    else if(AM.size()>2)
781                        AM.set(1, r2);
782                }
783                //if all these conditions are not met we do not want to set any tg modifiers
784                if (lineType == TacticalLines.PBS_SQUARE) //square
785                {
786                    double am0 = AM.get(0);
787                    if (AM.size() == 1) {
788                        AM.add(am0);
789                    } else if (AM.size() >= 2) {
790                        AM.set(1, am0);
791                    }
792                }
793                if (AN == null) {
794                    AN = new ArrayList();
795                }
796
797                if (AN.isEmpty()) {
798                    AN.add(0d);
799                }
800                if (AM != null && AM.size() > 1 && AN != null && AN.size() > 0) {
801                    String strT1 = Double.toString(AM.get(0));    //width
802                    String strH = Double.toString(AM.get(1));     //length
803                    //set width and length in meters for rectangular target
804                    tg.set_T1(strT1);
805                    tg.set_H(strH);
806                    //set attitude in mils
807                    String strH2 = Double.toString(AN.get(0));
808                    tg.set_H2(strH2);
809                }
810                if(AM.size()>2)
811                {
812                    String strH1 = Double.toString(AM.get(2));     //buffer size
813                    tg.set_H1(strH1);
814                }
815            }
816            //set rev D properties
817            //render_GE does this
818            //setTGProperties(tg);
819        } catch (Exception exc) {
820            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsRenderer", "createTGLightfromMilStdSymbol",
821                    new RendererException("Failed to build multipoint TG for " + milStd.getSymbolID(), exc));
822        }
823        return tg;
824    }

826    private static String createAltitudeLabel(double distance, DistanceUnit altitudeUnit, String altitudeLabel){
827        // Truncate the result
828        double result = distance * altitudeUnit.conversionFactor;
829        result *= 10.0;
830        result = Math.round(result);
831        int tempResult = (int) result;
832        result = tempResult / 10.0;
833
834        return result + " " + altitudeUnit.label + " " + altitudeLabel;
835    }

837    /**
838     * @deprecated @param milStd
839     * @param converter
840     * @param computeChannelPt
841     * @return
842     */
843    public static TGLight createTGLightFromMilStdSymbol(MilStdSymbol milStd,
844            IPointConversion converter, Boolean computeChannelPt) {
845        TGLight tg = new TGLight();
846        try {
847            String symbolId = milStd.getSymbolID();
848            tg.set_SymbolId(symbolId);
849            String status = tg.get_Status();
850            if (status != null && status.equals("A")) {
851                //lineStyle=GraphicProperties.LINE_TYPE_DASHED;
852                tg.set_LineStyle(1);
853            }
854            tg.set_VisibleModifiers(true);
855            //set tg latlongs and pixels
856            setClientCoords(milStd, tg);
857            //build tg.Pixels
858            tg.Pixels = clsUtility.LatLongToPixels(tg.LatLongs, converter);
859            tg.set_Font(new Font("Arial", Font.PLAIN, 12));
860            tg.set_FillColor(milStd.getFillColor());
861            tg.set_LineColor(milStd.getLineColor());
862            tg.set_LineThickness(milStd.getLineWidth());
863            tg.set_TexturePaint(milStd.getFillStyle());
864            tg.set_FontBackColor(Color.WHITE);
865            tg.set_TextColor(tg.get_LineColor());
866
867//            tg.set_DTG(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.W_DTG_1));
868//            tg.set_DTG1(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.W1_DTG_2));
869//            tg.set_H(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.H_ADDITIONAL_INFO_1));
870//            tg.set_H1(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.H1_ADDITIONAL_INFO_2));
871//            tg.set_H2(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.H2_ADDITIONAL_INFO_3));
872//            tg.set_Name(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.T_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_1));
873//            tg.set_T1(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.T1_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_2));
874//            tg.set_Location(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.Y_LOCATION));
875//            tg.set_N(ModifiersTG.N_HOSTILE);
876            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.W_DTG_1) != null) {
877                tg.set_DTG(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.W_DTG_1));
878            }
879            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.W1_DTG_2) != null) {
880                tg.set_DTG1(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.W1_DTG_2));
881            }
882            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.H_ADDITIONAL_INFO_1) != null) {
883                tg.set_H(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.H_ADDITIONAL_INFO_1));
884            }
885            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.H1_ADDITIONAL_INFO_2) != null) {
886                tg.set_H1(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.H1_ADDITIONAL_INFO_2));
887            }
888            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.H2_ADDITIONAL_INFO_3) != null) {
889                tg.set_H2(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.H2_ADDITIONAL_INFO_3));
890            }
891            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.T_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_1) != null) {
892                tg.set_Name(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.T_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_1));
893            }
894            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.T1_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_2) != null) {
895                tg.set_T1(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.T1_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_2));
896            }
897            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.Y_LOCATION) != null) {
898                tg.set_Location(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.Y_LOCATION));
899            }
900            if (milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.N_HOSTILE) != null) {
901                tg.set_N(milStd.getModifier(ModifiersTG.N_HOSTILE));
902            }
903
904            //int lineType=CELineArray.CGetLinetypeFromString(tg.get_SymbolId());
905            //int rev=tg.getSymbologyStandard();
906            int lineType = armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.GetLinetypeFromString(symbolId);
907            boolean isClosedArea = armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.isClosedPolygon(lineType);
908
909            if (isClosedArea) {
910                armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.ClosePolygon(tg.Pixels);
911                armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.ClosePolygon(tg.LatLongs);
912            }
913
914            //these channels need a channel point added
915            if (computeChannelPt) {
916                switch (lineType) {
917                    case TacticalLines.CATK:
918                    case TacticalLines.CATKBYFIRE:
919                    case TacticalLines.AAFNT:
920                    case TacticalLines.AAAAA:
921                    case TacticalLines.AIRAOA:
922                    case TacticalLines.MAIN:
923                    case TacticalLines.SPT:
924                    case TacticalLines.AXAD:
925                        POINT2 ptPixels = armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.ComputeLastPoint(tg.Pixels);
926                        tg.Pixels.add(ptPixels);
927                        //Point pt = clsUtility.POINT2ToPoint(ptPixels);
928                        Point2D pt = new Point2D.Double(ptPixels.x, ptPixels.y);
929                        //in case it needs the corresponding geo point
930                        Point2D ptGeo2d = converter.PixelsToGeo(pt);
931                        POINT2 ptGeo = clsUtility.Point2DToPOINT2(ptGeo2d);
932                        tg.LatLongs.add(ptGeo);
933                        //}
934                        break;
935                    default:
936                        break;
937                }
938            }
939        } catch (Exception exc) {
940            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsRenderer", "createTGLightfromMilStdSymbol",
941                    new RendererException("Failed to build multipoint TG for " + milStd.getSymbolID(), exc));
942        }
943        return tg;
944    }

1068    private static void Shape2ToShapeInfo(ArrayList<ShapeInfo> shapeInfos, ArrayList<Shape2> shapes) {

1073                return;
1074            }
1075
1076            for (j = 0; j < shapes.size(); j++) {
1077                shape = shapes.get(j);

1079            }
1080        } catch (Exception exc) {
1081            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsRenderer", "Shape2ToShapeInfo",
1082                    new RendererException("Failed to build ShapeInfo ArrayList", exc));
1083        }
1084    }

1086    /**
1087     * Added function to handle when coords or display area spans IDL but not
1088     * both, it prevents the symbol from rendering if the bounding rectangles
1089     * don't intersect.
1090     *
1091     * @param tg
1092     * @param converter
1093     * @param clipArea
1094     * @return
1095     */
1096    public static boolean intersectsClipArea(TGLight tg, IPointConversion converter, Object clipArea)
1097    {
1098        boolean result=false;
1099        try
1100        {
1101            if (clipArea==null || tg.LatLongs.size() < 2)
1102                return true;
1103            Rectangle2D clipBounds = null;
1104            ArrayList<Point2D> clipPoints = null;
1105            
1106//            if (clipArea != null) {
1107//                if (clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle2D.Double.class)) {
1108//                    clipBounds = (Rectangle2D.Double) clipArea;
1109//                } else if (clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle.class)) {
1110//                    clipBounds = (Rectangle2D) clipArea;
1111//                } else if (clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(ArrayList.class)) {
1112//                    clipPoints = (ArrayList<Point2D>) clipArea;
1113//                }
1114//            }
1115            if (clipArea != null) {
1116                if (clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle2D.Double.class)) {
1117                    clipBounds = (Rectangle2D.Double) clipArea;
1118                } else if (clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle.class)) {
1119                    Rectangle rectx = (Rectangle) clipArea;
1120                    clipBounds = new Rectangle2D.Double(rectx.x, rectx.y, rectx.width, rectx.height);
1121                } else if (clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(ArrayList.class)) {
1122                    clipPoints = (ArrayList<Point2D>) clipArea;                    
1123                    //double x0=clipPoints.get(0).getX(),y0=clipPoints.get(0).getY();
1124                    //double w=clipPoints.get(1).getX()-x0,h=clipPoints.get(3).getY()-y0;
1125                    //clipBounds = new Rectangle2D.Double(x0, y0, w, h);                    
1126                    clipBounds=clsUtility.getMBR(clipPoints);
1127                }
1128            }
1129            //assumes we are using clipBounds
1130            int j = 0;
1131            double x = clipBounds.getMinX();
1132            double y = clipBounds.getMinY();
1133            double width = clipBounds.getWidth();
1134            double height = clipBounds.getHeight();
1135            POINT2 tl = new POINT2(x, y);
1136            POINT2 br = new POINT2(x + width, y + height);
1137            tl = clsUtility.PointPixelsToLatLong(tl, converter);
1138            br = clsUtility.PointPixelsToLatLong(br, converter);
1139            //the latitude range
1140            //boolean ptInside = false, ptAbove = false, ptBelow = false;
1141            double coordsLeft = tg.LatLongs.get(0).x;
1142            double coordsRight = coordsLeft;
1143            double coordsTop=tg.LatLongs.get(0).y;
1144            double coordsBottom=coordsTop;
1145            boolean intersects=false;
1146            double minx=tg.LatLongs.get(0).x,maxx=minx,maxNegX=0;
1147            for (j = 0; j < tg.LatLongs.size(); j++)
1148            {                
1149                POINT2 pt=tg.LatLongs.get(j);
1150                if (pt.x < minx)
1151                    minx = pt.x;
1152                if (pt.x > maxx)
1153                    maxx = pt.x;
1154                if(maxNegX==0 && pt.x<0)
1155                    maxNegX=pt.x;
1156                if(maxNegX<0 && pt.x<0 && pt.x>maxNegX)
1157                    maxNegX=pt.x;
1158                if (pt.y < coordsBottom)
1159                    coordsBottom = pt.y;
1160                if (pt.y > coordsTop)
1161                    coordsTop = pt.y;                
1162            }
1163            boolean coordSpanIDL = false;
1164            if(maxx==180 || minx==-180)
1165                coordSpanIDL=true;
1166            if(maxx-minx>=180)
1167            {
1168                coordSpanIDL=true;
1169                coordsLeft=maxx;
1170                coordsRight=maxNegX;
1171            }else
1172            {
1173                coordsLeft=minx;
1174                coordsRight=maxx;
1175            }
1176            //if(canClipPoints)
1177            //{                
1178                if(br.y<=coordsBottom && coordsBottom <= tl.y)
1179                    intersects=true;
1180                else if(coordsBottom<=br.y && br.y <=coordsTop)
1181                    intersects=true;
1182                else
1183                    return false;
1184            //}
1185            //if it gets this far then the latitude ranges intersect
1186            //re-initialize intersects for the longitude ranges
1187            intersects=false;
1188            //the longitude range
1189            //the min and max coords longitude
1190            boolean boxSpanIDL = false;
1191            //boolean coordSpanIDL = false;
1192            if(tl.x==180 || tl.x==-180 || br.x==180 || br.x==-180)
1193                boxSpanIDL=true;
1194            else if (Math.abs(br.x - tl.x) > 180)
1195                boxSpanIDL = true;
1196            
1197//            if (coordsRight - coordsLeft > 180)
1198//            {
1199//                double temp = coordsLeft;
1200//                coordsLeft = coordsRight;
1201//                coordsRight = temp;
1202//                coordSpanIDL=true;
1203//            }
1204            //boolean intersects=false;
1205            if(coordSpanIDL && boxSpanIDL)
1206                intersects=true;
1207            else if(!coordSpanIDL && !boxSpanIDL)   //was && canclipPoints
1208            {
1209                if(coordsLeft<=tl.x && tl.x<=coordsRight)
1210                    intersects=true;
1211                if(coordsLeft<=br.x && br.x<=coordsRight)
1212                    intersects=true;
1213                if(tl.x<=coordsLeft && coordsLeft<=br.x)
1214                    intersects=true;
1215                if(tl.x<=coordsRight && coordsRight<=br.x)
1216                    intersects=true;
1217            }
1218            else if(!coordSpanIDL && boxSpanIDL)    //box spans IDL and coords do not
1219            {   
1220                if(tl.x<coordsRight && coordsRight<180)
1221                    intersects=true;
1222                if(-180<coordsLeft && coordsLeft<br.x)
1223                    intersects=true;
1224            }
1225            else if(coordSpanIDL && !boxSpanIDL)    //coords span IDL and box does not
1226            {   
1227                if(coordsLeft<br.x && br.x<180)
1228                    intersects=true;
1229                if(-180<tl.x && tl.x<coordsRight)
1230                    intersects=true;
1231            }
1232            return intersects;
1233            
1234        }
1235        catch (Exception exc) {
1236            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsRenderer", "intersectsClipArea",
1237                    new RendererException("Failed inside intersectsClipArea", exc));
1238        }    
1239        return result;
1240    }

1319    /**
1320     * Google Earth renderer: Called by mapfragment-demo This is the public
1321     * interface for Google Earth renderer assumes tg.Pixels is filled assumes
1322     * the caller instantiated the ShapeInfo arrays
1323     *
1324     * @param tg tactical graphic
1325     * @param shapeInfos symbol ShapeInfo array
1326     * @param modifierShapeInfos modifier ShapeInfo array
1327     * @param converter geographic to pixels coordinate converter
1328     * @param clipArea clipping bounds in pixels
1329     */
1330    public static void render_GE(TGLight tg,
1331            ArrayList<ShapeInfo> shapeInfos,
1332            ArrayList<ShapeInfo> modifierShapeInfos,
1333            IPointConversion converter,
1334            Object clipArea) {
1335        try {
1336            //set linetype for overhead wire
1337            getScale(tg, converter, clipArea);
1338
1339            Rectangle2D clipBounds = null;
1340            CELineArray.setClient("ge");
1341//            ArrayList<POINT2> origPixels = null;
1342//            ArrayList<POINT2> origLatLongs = null;
1343//            if (clsUtilityGE.segmentColorsSet(tg)) {
1344//                origPixels=lineutility.getDeepCopy(tg.Pixels);
1345//                origLatLongs=lineutility.getDeepCopy(tg.LatLongs);
1346//            }
1347            ArrayList<POINT2> origFillPixels = lineutility.getDeepCopy(tg.Pixels);
1348
1349            if (tg.get_LineType() == TacticalLines.LC || tg.get_LineType() == TacticalLines.LC_HOSTILE)
1350                armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.SegmentLCPoints(tg, converter);
1351
1352//            boolean shiftLines = Channels.getShiftLines();
1353//            if (shiftLines) {
1354//                String affiliation = tg.get_Affiliation();
1355//                Channels.setAffiliation(affiliation);
1356//            }
1357            //CELineArray.setMinLength(2.5);    //2-27-2013
1358            ArrayList<Point2D> clipPoints = null;
1359            if (clipArea != null) {
1360                if (clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle2D.Double.class)) {
1361                    clipBounds = (Rectangle2D.Double) clipArea;
1362                } else if (clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle.class)) {
1363                    Rectangle rectx = (Rectangle) clipArea;
1364                    clipBounds = new Rectangle2D.Double(rectx.x, rectx.y, rectx.width, rectx.height);
1365                } else if (clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(ArrayList.class)) {
1366                    clipPoints = (ArrayList<Point2D>) clipArea;
1367                }
1368            }
1369            double zoomFactor = clsUtilityGE.getZoomFactor(clipBounds, clipPoints, tg.Pixels);
1370            //add sub-section to test clipArea if client passes the rectangle
1371            boolean useClipPoints = false;    //currently not used
1372            if (useClipPoints == true && clipBounds != null) {
1373                double x = clipBounds.getMinX();
1374                double y = clipBounds.getMinY();
1375                double width = clipBounds.getWidth();
1376                double height = clipBounds.getHeight();
1377                clipPoints = new ArrayList();
1378                clipPoints.add(new Point2D.Double(x, y));
1379                clipPoints.add(new Point2D.Double(x + width, y));
1380                clipPoints.add(new Point2D.Double(x + width, y + height));
1381                clipPoints.add(new Point2D.Double(x, y + height));
1382                clipPoints.add(new Point2D.Double(x, y));
1383                clipBounds = null;
1384            }
1385            //end section
1386
1387            if (tg.get_Client() == null || tg.get_Client().isEmpty()) {
1388                tg.set_client("ge");
1389            }
1390
1391            armyc2.c2sd.JavaRendererServer.RenderMultipoints.clsUtility.RemoveDuplicatePoints(tg);
1392
1393            int rev = RendererSettings.getInstance().getSymbologyStandard();
1394            armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.initializeLinetypes(rev);
1395            armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.setRevC(tg);
1396
1397            int linetype = tg.get_LineType();
1398            if (linetype < 0) {
1399                linetype = armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.GetLinetypeFromString(tg.get_SymbolId());
1400                //clsUtilityCPOF.SegmentGeoPoints(tg, converter);
1401                tg.set_LineType(linetype);
1402            }
1403
1404            Boolean isTextFlipped = false;
1405            ArrayList<Shape2> shapes = null;   //use this to collect all the shapes
1406            clsUtilityGE.setSplineLinetype(tg);
1407            setHostileLC(tg);
1408
1409            clsUtilityCPOF.SegmentGeoPoints(tg, converter, zoomFactor);
1410            if (clipBounds != null || clipPoints != null) {
1411                if (clsUtilityCPOF.canClipPoints(tg)) {
1412                    //check assignment
1413                    if (clipBounds != null) {
1414                        clsClipPolygon2.ClipPolygon(tg, clipBounds);
1415                    } else if (clipPoints != null) {
1416                        clsClipQuad.ClipPolygon(tg, clipPoints);
1417                    }
1418
1419                    clsUtilityGE.removeTrailingPoints(tg, clipArea);
1420                    tg.LatLongs = clsUtility.PixelsToLatLong(tg.Pixels, converter);
1421                }
1422            }
1423
1424            //if MSR segment data set use original pixels unless tg.Pixels is empty from clipping
1425//            if (origPixels != null) {
1426//                if (tg.Pixels.isEmpty()) {
1427//                    return;
1428//                } else {
1429//                    tg.Pixels = origPixels;
1430//                    tg.LatLongs = origLatLongs;
1431//                    clipArea = null;
1432//                }
1433//            }
1434            armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.InterpolatePixels(tg);
1435
1436            tg.modifiers = new ArrayList();
1437            BufferedImage bi = new BufferedImage(8, 8, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
1438            Graphics2D g2d = bi.createGraphics();
1439            //Modifier2.AddModifiersGeo(tg, g2d, clipArea, converter);
1440            Modifier2.AddModifiersGeo2(tg, g2d, clipArea, converter);
1441
1442            clsUtilityCPOF.FilterPoints2(tg, converter);
1443            armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.FilterVerticalSegments(tg);
1444            clsUtility.FilterAXADPoints(tg, converter);
1445            clsUtilityCPOF.ClearPixelsStyle(tg);
1446
1447            ArrayList<Shape2> linesWithFillShapes = null;
1448
1449            ArrayList<POINT2> savePixels = tg.Pixels;
1450            tg.Pixels = origFillPixels;
1451
1452            //check assignment
1453            if (clipBounds != null) {
1454                linesWithFillShapes = clsClipPolygon2.LinesWithFill(tg, clipBounds);
1455            } else if (clipPoints != null) {
1456                linesWithFillShapes = clsClipQuad.LinesWithFill(tg, clipPoints);
1457            } else if (clipArea == null) {
1458                linesWithFillShapes = clsClipPolygon2.LinesWithFill(tg, clipBounds);
1459            }
1460
1461            tg.Pixels = savePixels;
1462
1463            ArrayList rangeFanFillShapes = null;
1464            //do not fill the original shapes for circular range fans
1465            int savefillStyle = tg.get_FillStyle();
1466            if (linetype == TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN) {
1467                tg.set_Fillstyle(0);
1468            }
1469
1470            //check assignment (pass which clip object is not null)
1471            if (clipBounds != null) {
1472                shapes = clsRenderer2.GetLineArray(tg, converter, isTextFlipped, clipBounds); //takes clip object           
1473            } else if (clipPoints != null) {
1474                shapes = clsRenderer2.GetLineArray(tg, converter, isTextFlipped, clipPoints);
1475            } else if (clipArea == null) {
1476                shapes = clsRenderer2.GetLineArray(tg, converter, isTextFlipped, clipBounds);
1477            }
1478
1479            switch (linetype) {
1480                case TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN:
1481                case TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_SECTOR:
1482                    if (tg.get_FillColor() == null || tg.get_FillColor().getAlpha() < 2) {
1483                        break;
1484                    }
1485                    TGLight tg1 = clsUtilityCPOF.GetCircularRangeFanFillTG(tg);
1486                    tg1.set_Fillstyle(savefillStyle);
1487                    tg1.set_SymbolId(tg.get_SymbolId());
1488                    //check assignment (pass which clip object is not null)
1489                    if (clipBounds != null) {
1490                        rangeFanFillShapes = clsRenderer2.GetLineArray(tg1, converter, isTextFlipped, clipBounds);
1491                    } else if (clipPoints != null) {
1492                        rangeFanFillShapes = clsRenderer2.GetLineArray(tg1, converter, isTextFlipped, clipPoints);
1493                    } else if (clipArea == null) {
1494                        rangeFanFillShapes = clsRenderer2.GetLineArray(tg1, converter, isTextFlipped, clipBounds);
1495                    }
1496
1497                    if (rangeFanFillShapes != null) {
1498                        if (shapes == null) {
1499                            System.out.println("shapes is null");
1500                            break;
1501                        } else {
1502                            shapes.addAll(0, rangeFanFillShapes);
1503                        }
1504
1505                    }
1506                    break;
1507                default:
1508                    clsRenderer2.getAutoshapeFillShape(tg, shapes);
1509                    break;
1510            }
1511            //end section
1512
1513            //undo any fillcolor for lines with fill
1514            clsUtilityCPOF.LinesWithSeparateFill(tg.get_LineType(), shapes);
1515            clsClipPolygon2.addAbatisFill(tg, shapes);
1516
1517            //if this line is commented then the extra line in testbed goes away
1518            if (shapes != null && linesWithFillShapes != null && linesWithFillShapes.size() > 0) {
1519                shapes.addAll(0, linesWithFillShapes);
1520            }
1521
1522            if (clsUtilityCPOF.canClipPoints(tg) == false && clipBounds != null) {
1523                shapes = clsUtilityCPOF.postClipShapes(tg, shapes, clipBounds);
1524            } else if (clsUtilityCPOF.canClipPoints(tg) == false && clipPoints != null) {
1525                shapes = clsUtilityCPOF.postClipShapes(tg, shapes, clipPoints);
1526            }
1527            resolvePostClippedShapes(tg,shapes);
1528            //returns early if textSpecs are null
1529            //currently the client is ignoring these
1530            if (modifierShapeInfos != null) {
1531                ArrayList<Shape2> textSpecs = new ArrayList();
1532                armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.Modifier2.DisplayModifiers2(tg, g2d, textSpecs, isTextFlipped, converter);
1533                Shape2ToShapeInfo(modifierShapeInfos, textSpecs);
1534            }
1535            Shape2ToShapeInfo(shapeInfos, shapes);
1536            //GE has no utility for building hatch fills from the texturepaint
1537            clsUtilityGE.buildHatchFills(tg, shapeInfos);
1538
1539            //check assignment (pass which clip object is not null)
1540            if (clipBounds != null) {
1541                clsUtilityGE.SetShapeInfosPolylines(tg, shapeInfos, clipBounds);//takes a clip object            
1542            } else if (clipPoints != null) {
1543                clsUtilityGE.SetShapeInfosPolylines(tg, shapeInfos, clipPoints);
1544            } else if (clipArea == null) {
1545                clsUtilityGE.SetShapeInfosPolylines(tg, shapeInfos, clipBounds);
1546            }
1547        } catch (Exception exc) {
1548            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "render_GE",
1549                    new RendererException("Failed inside render_GE", exc));
1550
1551        }
1552    }
1553    /**
1554     * creates a shape for known symbols. The intent is to use client points for
1555     * the shape and is intended for use with ellipse. If hatch > 1 it creates 2 shapes
1556     * one for the hatch pattern, the second one is for the outline.
1557     *
1558     * @param milStd
1559     * @param ipc
1560     * @param clipArea
1561     * @param shapeType
1562     * @param lineColor
1563     * @param fillColor
1564     * @param hatch
1565     */
1566    public static void render_Shape(MilStdSymbol milStd,
1567            IPointConversion ipc,
1568            Object clipArea,
1569            int shapeType,
1570            Color lineColor,
1571            Color fillColor,
1572            int hatch) {
1573        try {
1574            Rectangle2D clipBounds = null;
1575            //CELineArray.setClient("ge");
1576            ArrayList<Point2D> clipPoints = null;
1577
1578            if (clipArea != null) {
1579                if (clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle2D.Double.class)) {
1580                    clipBounds = (Rectangle2D.Double) clipArea;
1581                } else if (clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle.class)) {
1582                    clipBounds = (Rectangle2D) clipArea;
1583                } else if (clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(ArrayList.class)) {
1584                    clipPoints = (ArrayList<Point2D>) clipArea;
1585                }
1586            }
1587            
1588            //can't use following line because it resets the pixels
1589            //TGLight tg = createTGLightFromMilStdSymbol(milStd, ipc);
1590            TGLight tg = new TGLight();
1591            tg.set_SymbolId(milStd.getSymbolID());
1592            //tg.set_VisibleModifiers(true);
1593            //set tg latlongs and pixels
1594            setClientCoords(milStd, tg);
1595            //build tg.Pixels
1596            tg.Pixels = clsUtility.LatLongToPixels(tg.LatLongs, ipc);            
1597            
1598            //int fillStyle = milStd.getPatternFillType();
1599            Shape2 shape = new Shape2(shapeType);
1600            shape.setFillColor(fillColor);
1601            if (lineColor != null) {
1602                shape.setLineColor(lineColor);
1603                shape.setStroke(new BasicStroke(milStd.getLineWidth()));
1604            }
1605            //the client has already set the coordinates for the shape
1606            POINT2 pt;
1607            for (int j = 0; j < tg.Pixels.size(); j++) {
1608                pt = tg.Pixels.get(j);
1609                if (j == 0) {
1610                    shape.moveTo(pt);
1611                } else {
1612                    shape.lineTo(pt);
1613                }
1614            }
1615
1616            //post clip the shape and set the polylines
1617            ArrayList<Shape2> shapes = new ArrayList();
1618            shapes.add(shape);
1619            //post-clip the shape
1620            if (clsUtilityCPOF.canClipPoints(tg) == false && clipBounds != null) {
1621                shapes = clsUtilityCPOF.postClipShapes(tg, shapes, clipBounds);
1622            } else if (clsUtilityCPOF.canClipPoints(tg) == false && clipPoints != null) {
1623                shapes = clsUtilityCPOF.postClipShapes(tg, shapes, clipPoints);
1624            }
1625            shape=shapes.get(0);
1626            if (hatch > 1) 
1627            {
1628                shape = clsUtilityGE.buildHatchFill(tg, shape, hatch);
1629                shape.setLineColor(lineColor);
1630                shape.setStroke(new BasicStroke(1));
1631                //shapes.clear();
1632                shapes.add(shape);
1633            }
1634            ArrayList<ShapeInfo> shapeInfos = new ArrayList();
1635            Shape2ToShapeInfo(shapeInfos, shapes);
1636            //set the shapeInfo polylines
1637            if (clipBounds != null) {
1638                clsUtilityGE.SetShapeInfosPolylines(tg, shapeInfos, clipBounds);
1639            } else if (clipPoints != null) {
1640                clsUtilityGE.SetShapeInfosPolylines(tg, shapeInfos, clipPoints);
1641            } else if (clipArea == null) {
1642                clsUtilityGE.SetShapeInfosPolylines(tg, shapeInfos, clipBounds);
1643            }
1644            //set milStd symbol shapes
1645            if (milStd.getSymbolShapes() == null) {
1646                milStd.setSymbolShapes(shapeInfos);
1647            } else {
1648                milStd.getSymbolShapes().addAll(shapeInfos);
1649            }
1650            return;
1651        } catch (Exception exc) {
1652            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "render_Shape",
1653                    new RendererException("Failed inside render_Shape", exc));
1654
1655        }
1656    }
1657    private static void resolvePostClippedShapes(TGLight tg, ArrayList<Shape2> shapes) {
1658        try {
1659            //resolve the PBS and BBS shape properties after the post clip, regardless whether they were clipped
1660            switch (tg.get_LineType()) {
1661                case TacticalLines.BBS_RECTANGLE:
1662                case TacticalLines.BBS_POINT:
1663                case TacticalLines.BBS_LINE:
1664                case TacticalLines.BBS_AREA:
1665                case TacticalLines.PBS_RECTANGLE:
1666                case TacticalLines.PBS_SQUARE:
1667                case TacticalLines.PBS_CIRCLE:
1668                case TacticalLines.PBS_ELLIPSE:
1669                    break;
1670                default:
1671                    return;
1672            }
1673            Color fillColor = tg.get_FillColor();
1674            shapes.get(0).setFillColor(fillColor);
1675            shapes.get(1).setFillColor(null);
1676            int fillStyle = tg.get_FillStyle();
1677            shapes.get(0).set_Fillstyle(0);
1678            shapes.get(1).set_Fillstyle(fillStyle);
1679            return;
1680
1681        } catch (Exception exc) {
1682            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "render_GE",
1683                    new RendererException("Failed inside resolvePostClippedShapes", exc));
1684
1685        }
1686    }
1687    /**
1688     * to follow right hand rule for LC when affiliation is hostile. also fixes
1689     * MSDZ point order and maybe various other wayward symbols
1690     *
1691     * @param tg
1692     */
1693    private static void setHostileLC(TGLight tg) {
1694        try {
1695            Boolean usas1314 = true;
1696            ArrayList<POINT2> pts = new ArrayList();
1697            int j = 0;
1698            switch (tg.get_LineType()) {
1699                case TacticalLines.LC:
1700                    if (usas1314 == false) {
1701                        break;
1702                    }
1703                    if (tg.get_Affiliation() != null && !tg.get_Affiliation().equals("H")) {
1704                        break;
1705                    }
1706                    pts = (ArrayList<POINT2>) tg.Pixels.clone();
1707                    for (j = 0; j < tg.Pixels.size(); j++) {
1708                        tg.Pixels.set(j, pts.get(pts.size() - j - 1));
1709                    }
1710                    //reverse the latlongs also
1711                    pts = (ArrayList<POINT2>) tg.LatLongs.clone();
1712                    for (j = 0; j < tg.LatLongs.size(); j++) {
1713                        tg.LatLongs.set(j, pts.get(pts.size() - j - 1));
1714                    }
1715                    break;
1716                case TacticalLines.LINE:    //CPOF client requests reverse orientation
1717                    pts = (ArrayList<POINT2>) tg.Pixels.clone();
1718                    for (j = 0; j < tg.Pixels.size(); j++) {
1719                        tg.Pixels.set(j, pts.get(pts.size() - j - 1));
1720                    }
1721                    //reverse the latlongs also
1722                    pts = (ArrayList<POINT2>) tg.LatLongs.clone();
1723                    for (j = 0; j < tg.LatLongs.size(); j++) {
1724                        tg.LatLongs.set(j, pts.get(pts.size() - j - 1));
1725                    }
1726                    break;
1727                default:
1728                    return;
1729            }
1730        } catch (Exception exc) {
1731            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "setHostileLC",
1732                    new RendererException("Failed inside setHostileLC", exc));
1733
1734        }
1735    }

1737    /**
1738     * Calculates the scale using the converter and the clipBounds and sets
1739     * overhead wire type based on the scale
1740     *
1741     * @param tg
1742     * @param converter
1743     * @param clipBounds
1744     * @return
1745     */
1746    protected static double getScale(TGLight tg,
1747            IPointConversion converter,
1748            Object clipBounds) {
1749        double scale = 0;
1750        try {
1751            int lineType = tg.get_LineType();
1752            if (lineType != TacticalLines.OVERHEAD_WIRE) {
1753                return 0;
1754            }
1755            if (clipBounds == null || converter == null) {
1756                return 0;
1757            }
1758
1759            Rectangle2D clipRect = null;
1760            //ArrayList<Point2D> clipArray=null;            
1761            if (clipBounds.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle2D.Double.class)) {
1762                clipRect = (Rectangle2D) clipBounds;
1763            } else if (clipBounds.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle2D.class)) {
1764                clipRect = (Rectangle2D) clipBounds;
1765            } else if (clipBounds.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle.class)) {
1766                Rectangle rectx = (Rectangle) clipBounds;
1767                clipRect = new Rectangle2D.Double(rectx.x, rectx.y, rectx.width, rectx.height);
1768            } else if (clipBounds.getClass().isAssignableFrom(ArrayList.class)) {
1769                ArrayList<Point2D> clipArray = (ArrayList<Point2D>) clipBounds;
1770                clipRect = armyc2.c2sd.JavaRendererServer.RenderMultipoints.clsUtility.getMBR(clipArray);
1771            }
1772
1773            double left = clipRect.getMinX();
1774            double right = clipRect.getMaxX();
1775            double distanceInPixels = Math.abs(right - left);
1776            double top = clipRect.getMinY();
1777            Point2D ul = new Point2D.Double(left, top);
1778            Point2D ur = new Point2D.Double(right, top);
1779            Point2D ulGeo = converter.PixelsToGeo(ul);
1780            Point2D urGeo = converter.PixelsToGeo(ur);
1781            POINT2 pt2ulGeo = new POINT2(ulGeo.getX(), ulGeo.getY());
1782            POINT2 pt2urGeo = new POINT2(urGeo.getX(), urGeo.getY());
1783            double distanceInMeters = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(pt2ulGeo, pt2urGeo, null, null);
1784            //sccale=(distanceInPixels pixels/distanceInMeters meters)*(1 inch/96 pixels)*(1 meter/ 39.37 inch)
1785            scale = (distanceInPixels / distanceInMeters) * (1.0d / 96.0d) * (1.0d / 39.37d);
1786            scale = 1.0d / scale;
1787            //reset the linetype for overhead wire if the sclae is large
1788            if (lineType == TacticalLines.OVERHEAD_WIRE && scale >= 250000 && tg.get_SymbolId().length() < 20) {
1789                tg.set_LineType(TacticalLines.OVERHEAD_WIRE_LS);
1790            }
1791        } catch (Exception exc) {
1792            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "getScale",
1793                    new RendererException("Failed inside getScale", exc));
1794
1795        }
1796        return scale;
1797    }
