1799    /**
1800     * set the clip rectangle as an arraylist or a Rectangle2D depending on the
1801     * object
1802     *
1803     * @param clipBounds
1804     * @param clipRect
1805     * @param clipArray
1806     * @return
1807     */
1808    private static boolean setClip(Object clipBounds, Rectangle2D clipRect, ArrayList<Point2D> clipArray) {
1809        try {
1810            if (clipBounds == null) {
1811                return false;
1812            } else if (clipBounds.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle2D.Double.class)) {
1813                clipRect.setRect((Rectangle2D) clipBounds);
1814            } else if (clipBounds.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle2D.class)) {
1815                clipRect.setRect((Rectangle2D) clipBounds);
1816            } else if (clipBounds.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle.class)) {
1817                //clipRect.setRect((Rectangle2D)clipBounds);
1818                Rectangle rectx = (Rectangle) clipBounds;
1819                //clipBounds=new Rectangle2D.Double(rectx.x,rectx.y,rectx.width,rectx.height);
1820                clipRect.setRect(rectx.x, rectx.y, rectx.width, rectx.height);
1821            } else if (clipBounds.getClass().isAssignableFrom(ArrayList.class)) {
1822                clipArray.addAll((ArrayList) clipBounds);
1823            }
1824        } catch (Exception exc) {
1825            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "setClip",
1826                    new RendererException("Failed inside setClip", exc));
1827
1828        }
1829        return true;
1830    }

1854    /**
1855     * Generic tester button says Tiger or use JavaRendererSample. Generic
1856     * renderer testers: called by JavaRendererSample and TestJavaLineArray
1857     * public render function transferred from JavaLineArrayCPOF project. Use
1858     * this function to replicate CPOF renderer functionality.
1859     *
1860     * @param tg tactical graphic
1861     * @param converter geographic to pixels converter
1862     * @param shapeInfos ShapeInfo array
1863     * @param modifierShapeInfos modifier ShapeInfo array
1864     * @param clipBounds clip bounds
1865     */
1866    public static void render(MilStdSymbol mss,
1867            IPointConversion converter,
1868            ArrayList<ShapeInfo> shapeInfos,
1869            ArrayList<ShapeInfo> modifierShapeInfos,
1870            Object clipBounds) {
1871        try {
1872            //boolean shiftLines = Channels.getShiftLines();
1873            //end section
1874
1875            Rectangle2D clipRect = new Rectangle2D.Double();
1876            ArrayList<Point2D> clipArray = new ArrayList();
1877            setClip(clipBounds, clipRect, clipArray);
1878
1879            int rev = mss.getSymbologyStandard();
1880            armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.initializeLinetypes(rev);
1881            TGLight tg = createTGLightFromMilStdSymbol(mss, converter);
1882            CELineArray.setClient("generic");
1883//            if (shiftLines) {
1884//                String affiliation = tg.get_Affiliation();
1885//                Channels.setAffiliation(affiliation);
1886//            }
1887            //CELineArray.setMinLength(2.5);    //2-27-2013
1888
1889            //if(rev==RendererSettings.Symbology_2525C)
1890            //{
1891            armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.setRevC(tg);
1892            //}
1893            //resets the linetypes for overhead wire and other rev c symbols
1894            double scale = getScale(tg, converter, clipBounds);
1895
1896            int linetype = tg.get_LineType();
1897            //replace calls to MovePixels
1898            armyc2.c2sd.JavaRendererServer.RenderMultipoints.clsUtility.RemoveDuplicatePoints(tg);
1899
1900            setHostileLC(tg);
1901
1902            BufferedImage bi = new BufferedImage(8, 8, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
1903            Graphics2D g2d = bi.createGraphics();
1904
1905            clsUtilityCPOF.SegmentGeoPoints(tg, converter, 1);
1906            clsUtility.FilterAXADPoints(tg, converter);
1907
1908            //prevent vertical segments for oneway, twoway, alt
1909            armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.FilterVerticalSegments(tg);
1910            boolean isChange1Area = armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.IsChange1Area(linetype, null);
1911            boolean isTextFlipped = false;
1912            //for 3d change 1 symbols we do not transform the points
1913
1914            //if it is world view then we want to flip the far points about
1915            //the left and right sides to get two symbols
1916            ArrayList<POINT2> farLeftPixels = new ArrayList();
1917            ArrayList<POINT2> farRightPixels = new ArrayList();
1918            if (isChange1Area == false) {
1919                clsUtilityCPOF.GetFarPixels(tg, converter, farLeftPixels, farRightPixels);
1920            }
1921
1922            ArrayList<Shape2> shapesLeft = new ArrayList();
1923            ArrayList<Shape2> shapesRight = new ArrayList();
1924            ArrayList<Shape2> shapes = null;   //use this to collect all the shapes
1925
1926            //CPOF 6.0 diagnostic
1927            ArrayList<Shape2> textSpecsLeft = null;
1928            ArrayList<Shape2> textSpecsRight = null;
1929            //Note: DisplayModifiers3 returns early if textSpecs are null
1930            textSpecsLeft = new ArrayList();
1931            textSpecsRight = new ArrayList();
1932
1933            if (farLeftPixels.size() > 0) {
1934                tg.Pixels = farLeftPixels;
1935                shapesLeft = clsRenderer2.GetLineArray(tg, converter, isTextFlipped, clipBounds);
1936                //CPOF 6.0
1937                //returns early if textSpecs are null
1938                armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.Modifier2.DisplayModifiers2(tg, g2d, textSpecsLeft, isTextFlipped, null);
1939            }
1940            if (farRightPixels.size() > 0) {
1941                tg.Pixels = farRightPixels;
1942                shapesRight = clsRenderer2.GetLineArray(tg, converter, isTextFlipped, clipBounds);
1943                //CPOF 6.0
1944                //returns early if textSpecs are null
1945                armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.Modifier2.DisplayModifiers2(tg, g2d, textSpecsRight, isTextFlipped, null);
1946            }
1947
1948            //CPOF 6.0 diagnostic
1949            ArrayList<Shape2> textSpecs = new ArrayList();
1950
1951            if (shapesLeft.isEmpty() || shapesRight.isEmpty()) {
1952                ArrayList<Shape2> linesWithFillShapes = null;
1953                if (clipArray != null && !clipArray.isEmpty()) {
1954                    linesWithFillShapes = clsClipQuad.LinesWithFill(tg, clipArray);
1955                } else if (clipRect != null && clipRect.getWidth() != 0) {
1956                    linesWithFillShapes = clsClipPolygon2.LinesWithFill(tg, clipRect);
1957                } else {
1958                    linesWithFillShapes = clsClipPolygon2.LinesWithFill(tg, null);
1959                }
1960
1961                //diagnostic: comment two lines if using the WW tester
1962                if (clsUtilityCPOF.canClipPoints(tg) && clipBounds != null) {
1963                    if (clipArray != null && !clipArray.isEmpty()) {
1964                        clsClipQuad.ClipPolygon(tg, clipArray);
1965                    } else if (clipRect != null && clipRect.getWidth() != 0) {
1966                        clsClipPolygon2.ClipPolygon(tg, clipRect);
1967                    }
1968
1969                    tg.LatLongs = clsUtility.PixelsToLatLong(tg.Pixels, converter);
1970                }
1971
1972                //diagnostic 1-28-13
1973                armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.InterpolatePixels(tg);
1974
1975                tg.modifiers = new ArrayList();
1976                Modifier2.AddModifiersGeo(tg, g2d, clipBounds, converter);
1977
1978                clsUtilityCPOF.FilterPoints2(tg, converter);
1979                clsUtilityCPOF.ClearPixelsStyle(tg);
1980                //add section to replace preceding line M. Deutch 11-4-2011
1981                ArrayList rangeFanFillShapes = null;
1982                //do not fill the original shapes for circular range fans
1983                int savefillStyle = tg.get_FillStyle();
1984                if (linetype == TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN) {
1985                    tg.set_Fillstyle(0);
1986                }
1987
1988                shapes = clsRenderer2.GetLineArray(tg, converter, isTextFlipped, clipBounds);
1989
1990                switch (linetype) {
1991                    case TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN:
1992                    case TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_SECTOR:
1993                        TGLight tg1 = clsUtilityCPOF.GetCircularRangeFanFillTG(tg);
1994                        tg1.set_Fillstyle(savefillStyle);
1995                        rangeFanFillShapes = clsRenderer2.GetLineArray(tg1, converter, isTextFlipped, clipBounds);
1996
1997                        if (rangeFanFillShapes != null) {
1998                            shapes.addAll(0, rangeFanFillShapes);
1999                        }
2000                        break;
2001                    default:
2002                        break;
2003                }
2004
2005                //undo any fillcolor for lines with fill
2006                clsUtilityCPOF.LinesWithSeparateFill(tg.get_LineType(), shapes);
2007                clsClipPolygon2.addAbatisFill(tg, shapes);
2008
2009                //if this line is commented then the extra line in testbed goes away
2010                if (shapes != null && linesWithFillShapes != null && linesWithFillShapes.size() > 0) {
2011                    shapes.addAll(0, linesWithFillShapes);
2012                }
2013
2014                if (shapes != null && shapes.size() > 0) {
2015                    armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.Modifier2.DisplayModifiers2(tg, g2d, textSpecs, isTextFlipped, null);
2016                    Shape2ToShapeInfo(modifierShapeInfos, textSpecs);
2017                    mss.setModifierShapes(modifierShapeInfos);
2018                }
2019            } else //symbol was more than 180 degrees wide, use left and right symbols
2020            {
2021                shapes = shapesLeft;
2022                shapes.addAll(shapesRight);
2023
2024                if (textSpecs != null) {
2025                    textSpecs.addAll(textSpecsLeft);
2026                    textSpecs.addAll(textSpecsRight);
2027                }
2028            }
2029            //post-clip the points if the tg could not be pre-clipped
2030            if (clsUtilityCPOF.canClipPoints(tg) == false && clipBounds != null) {
2031                shapes = clsUtilityCPOF.postClipShapes(tg, shapes, clipBounds);
2032            }
2033
2034            Shape2ToShapeInfo(shapeInfos, shapes);
2035            mss.setSymbolShapes(shapeInfos);
2036        } catch (Exception exc) {
2037            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "render",
2038                    new RendererException("Failed inside render", exc));
2039
2040        }
2041    }

2089            case 120102:
2090                return TacticalLines.NAI;
2091            case 120103:
2092                return TacticalLines.TAI;

2094                return TacticalLines.AIRFIELD;
2095            case 140100:
2096            case 140101:
2097            case 140102:
2098            case 140103:
2099            case 140104:
2100                return TacticalLines.FLOT;
2101            case 140200:
2102                return TacticalLines.LC;
2103            case 140300:
2104                return TacticalLines.PL;
2105            case 140400:                //new FEBA as a line, new label
2106            case 140401:

2110            case 140601:

2605    /**
2606     * Rev D symbols
2607     *
2608     * @param tg
2609     * @param setA
2610     * @param setB
2611     */
2612    public static void setTGProperties(TGLight tg) {
2613        try {
2614            if (tg.get_SymbolId().length() < 20) {
2615                return;
2616            }
2617            String setA = tg.get_SymbolId().substring(0, 10);
2618            String setB = tg.get_SymbolId().substring(10);
2619            //String symbolSet = getSymbolSet(setA);
2620            String symbolSet = setA.substring(4, 6);
2621            int nSymbolSet = Integer.parseInt(symbolSet);
2622            if (nSymbolSet != 25) {
2623                return;
2624            }
2625            //String code = Modifier2.getCode(setB);
2626            String code = setB.substring(0, 6);
2627            int nCode = Integer.parseInt(code);
2628            switch (nCode) {
2629                case 140101:    //friendly present flot
2630                    break;
2631                case 140102:
2632                    tg.set_LineStyle(1);
2633                    break;
2634                case 140103:
2635                    break;
2636                case 140104:
2637                case 140607:
2638                case 150102:
2639                case 150104:
2640                    tg.set_LineStyle(1);
2641                    break;
2642                case 140604:
2643                case 140401:
2644                case 220104:
2645                case 240807:
2646                case 151405:
2647                case 150400:
2648                    tg.set_LineStyle(1);
2649                    break;
2650                case 151802:
2651                case 140606:
2652                case 150501:
2653                case 150502:
2654                case 150503:
2655                    break;
2656                case 151407:
2657                    tg.set_Name("");
2658                    break;
2659                case 151408:
2660                    tg.set_Name("");
2661                    tg.set_LineStyle(1);
2662                    break;
2663                case 200101:
2664                    tg.set_FillColor(new Color(255, 155, 0, 191));
2665                    break;
2666                case 200201:
2667                case 200202:
2668                    tg.set_FillColor(new Color(85, 119, 136, 191));
2669                    break;
2670                case 270100:
2671                    tg.set_T1("");
2672                    break;
2673                case 290301:
2674                case 290305:
2675                case 290306:
2676                case 290307:
2677                case 290308:
2678                case 290309:
2679                    clsRenderer.reversePointsRevD(tg);
2680                    break;
2681                default:
2682                    break;
2683            }
2684        } catch (Exception exc) {
2685            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "setTGProperties",
2686                    new RendererException("Failed inside setTGProperties", exc));
2687        }
2688    }
2689
2690    private static void reversePointsRevD(TGLight tg) {
2691        try {
2692            int j = 0;
2693            ArrayList pts = null;
2694            if (tg.get_SymbolId().length() < 20) {
2695                return;
2696            }
2697            String setB = tg.get_SymbolId().substring(10);
2698            String entityCode = setB.substring(0, 6);
2699            int nCode = Integer.parseInt(entityCode);
2700            switch (nCode) {
2701                case 290301:
2702                case 290305:
2703                case 290306:
2704                case 290307:
2705                case 290308:
2706                case 290309:
2707                    if (tg.Pixels != null) {
2708                        pts = (ArrayList<POINT2>) tg.Pixels.clone();
2709                        for (j = 0; j < tg.Pixels.size(); j++) {
2710                            tg.Pixels.set(j, (POINT2) pts.get(pts.size() - j - 1));
2711                        }
2712                    }
2713                    if (tg.LatLongs != null) {
2714                        pts = (ArrayList<POINT2>) tg.LatLongs.clone();
2715                        for (j = 0; j < tg.LatLongs.size(); j++) {
2716                            tg.LatLongs.set(j, (POINT2) pts.get(pts.size() - j - 1));
2717                        }
2718                    }
2719                    break;
2720                default:
2721                    break;
2722            }
2723
2724        } catch (Exception exc) {
2725            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsRenderer", "renderWithPolylines",
2726                    new RendererException("Failed inside renderWithPolylines", exc));
2727        }
2728    }

2730    /**
2731     * sets tactical graphic line type for rev D and below
2732     *
2733     * @param tg
2734     */
2735    public static int getRevDLinetype(TGLight tg) {
2736        int linetype = -1;
2737        try {
2738            String symbolId = tg.get_SymbolId();
2739            if (symbolId.length() > 15) //rev D
2740            {
2741                //String setA = Modifier2.getSetA(symbolId);
2742                String setA = symbolId.substring(0, 10);
2743                //String setB = Modifier2.getSetB(symbolId);
2744                String setB = symbolId.substring(10);
2745                //String code = Modifier2.getCode(setB);
2746                String code = setB.substring(0, 6);
2747                //String symbolSet = Modifier2.getSymbolSet(setA);
2748                String symbolSet = setA.substring(4, 6);
2749                int nSymbol = Integer.parseInt(symbolSet);
2750                if (nSymbol == 25) {
2751                    linetype = getCMLineType(symbolSet, code);
2752                    //setTGProperties(tg);
2753                } else if (nSymbol == 45 || nSymbol == 46) {
2754                    linetype = clsMETOC.getWeatherLinetype(symbolSet, code);
2755                }
2756
2757            } else //not rev D            
2758            {
2759                linetype = armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.GetLinetypeFromString(symbolId);
2760            }
2761
2762            tg.set_LineType(linetype);
2763        } catch (Exception exc) {
2764            ErrorLogger.LogException("clsRenderer", "setRevDLinetype",
2765                    new RendererException("Failed in setRevDLinetype ", exc));
2766        }
2767        return linetype;
2768    }
